calculation.description: Ranks assets that have underperformed their contemporaneous cross-asset mean over the prior 10 sessions, scaled by the ratio of long-run to short-run volatility. The one-day shift ensures only completed-day information is used. Higher values indicate a stronger residual pullback opportunity, with volatility compression receiving greater emphasis.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day IC was positive in 2024-2026 (0.16621, 106 dates), 2027-2029 (0.02200, 782 dates), and 2030-2032 (0.02855, 587 dates). The 2020-2023 segment had no usable common-date observations under the available price history alignment. Interpret small-universe IC uncertainty conservatively; all dates averaged about 15 instruments. Admission gates met: absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840.
